programme.title: Fabric to Fashion Episode 2
programme.desc: Fabric to Fashion is a reality show featuring designers and sewist from all over the world. Angela Wolf mentors and guides the designers throughout each challenge, and often throws in a few extra twists!

programme.desc: Gifted Madhubani artist teaches how to create a simple DIY over Madhubani Art.

programme.desc: Bihar's paper mache masters teach how to make unique crafts with paper mache technique.

programme.title: Logan's Syndrome
programme.desc: How would you cope with two rare genetic diseases, one of which makes you look very different and the other one likely to kill you? What would you focus on to bring you happiness and help you feel like you belong in society? "Logan's Syndrome" is a personal documentary about one such man. Born to healthy parents, Logan Madsen and sister Heather share a life-threatening lung disease and Miller syndrome, which affects fewer than thirty people in the world.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Platform Bed - The Headboard
programme.desc: The massive headboard comes together with a wenge raised panel and a beautiful solid bubinga frame!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Knife Block
programme.desc: This video shows you how to build a Knife Block, designed by Chris Schwarz. It's a fun little project that makes a great gift, especially if you're sick of giving people cutting boards as presents!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack
programme.desc: This video shows you how to build the Wall-Hanging Magazine Rack, designed by Glen Huey. And because I don't like to leave well enough alone, I'll also show you an alternative version of the magazine rack that employs a few of my personal design changes.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Turning a Tool Handle
programme.desc: If you have a lathe, turning a tool handle is a breeze. Beautiful custom tool handles are just minutes away!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tenons on the Bandsaw
programme.desc: If you are one of those folks who wants to begin detaching from the tablesaw, you're going to need to find alternative methods for doing the things that we typically use the tablesaw for, such as cutting tenons. Fortunately, the bandsaw is a very good alternative.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig MJ Splitter SteelPRO
programme.desc: In the past, we have discussed the use of Featherboards & Pushsticks as well as the benefits of using something like MicroJig's GRR-Ripper. But the one safety device we have yet to focus on, which could be considered the most important, is the tablesaw splitter/riving knife.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking Gauges
programme.desc: If you're not using marking gauges or some sort of blade to lay out your joinery, you are really missing out! I remember a conversation I had with William Ng at the William Ng School when he told me, "If you want to make good joinery, use a pencil. But if you want to make great joinery, using a knife!"

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sanding Efficiency
programme.desc: Sanding is one of those tasks that nobody enjoys. So in order to get the best results with the least amount of effort, we need to consider the things that have the most dramatic effect on our sanding efficiency.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: My New Outfeed Table
programme.desc: Years ago, I borrowed some inspiration from Norm and built a simple plywood work table and used it as my tablesaw outfeed table. That original table is long gone but I recently built another one. I did include some changes and that's what this video is about. I think this design is a little better, but it was all based on the original concept.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Waterborne Finishes & HVLP
programme.desc: Technically, this is really Part 4 of our Wall-Hanging Tool Chest build, but because I focused so strongly on waterborne finishes and HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure spraying), it received its own stand-alone title.
